nodes.label: ADR 0192: Scrub the Prepare deck like vinyl: the track in an AudioWorklet platter, the player taking over on release
nodes.rationale: Context: dragging the deck set the audio element's currentTime on every pointer move, a jump in the waveform, which is a click; an audio element can't play backwards or bend its speed sample by sample, while a record under a hand does both with pitch following speed. Alternatives rejected: gentler seeking (still jumps, no reverse or speed); a Web Audio graph replacing the player for Prepare (key lock and every source kind belong to the element; the platter is only for the moments the deck is held); AudioBufferSourceNode.playbackRate (cannot go backwards, and stepping its rate zips). Consequences: the open track's samples (about 90 MB for a 4-minute stereo track at 48 kHz) are held while Prepare is open; key lock does not apply while the deck is held and applies again after the handover; a long song seeks as before until decoded (data-vinyl on the deck says which). Accepted 2026-11-01 after the user asked for a vinyl feel with no clicking.

nodes.label: Platter: AudioWorklet processor holding the decoded track
nodes.rationale: Samples decoded once in the background at the context's rate (decodeAudio), loaded into an AudioWorklet from a Blob. Held: pulls the record towards the hand (25 ms pull) through a platter with mass (14 ms smoothing, at most 6x speed). Motor: returns to the tempo (player.rate, 70 ms smoothing). Brake: slows to a stop and reports where. Cubic interpolation, low-passed when faster than the record; fades in and out (8 ms, 40 ms). Output goes to the player's device (setSinkId) at the player's volume.

nodes.label: Handover from the platter to the player
nodes.rationale: While the deck is held the player keeps running at volume 0, so taking over is a seek, not a start. Let go playing: the motor runs 260 ms, then the player seeks to the record's position plus 40 ms (where the platter will be when the seek lands), and the two crossfade over 40 ms. Let go paused: the brake, then a silent seek to where it stopped.

nodes.label: Scrub engine (scratch.svelte.ts)
nodes.rationale: The deck's grab, move and release become platter messages; its position, extrapolated between reports, draws the deck while held.

hyperedges.label: Vinyl scrub flow: the engine feeds the platter, which hands over to the player
